explanation: Britain's Charlotte Cooper won the tennis singles there, the first woman to win an individual Olympic event. No women had competed at the first modern Games in Athens.

claims.text: Women first competed at the modern Olympic Games at Paris 1900.
No women competed at Athens 1896, and London 1908 and Stockholm 1912 came after women's Olympic debut.
Charlotte Cooper of Great Britain won the women's tennis singles at Paris 1900, becoming the first woman to win an individual Olympic event.
